name: v2.66.0
body:
## Changelog
* e8bc5b6f27c673784cf7265bd2faabf3a47b8ba1: fix(baremetal): add option type (#6765) (Scaleway Bot <github@scaleway.com>)

## What's Changed

### Feat

* feat(audit-trail): improve visualization by @remyleone in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6521
* feat(k8s): add pool private network by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6524
* feat(instance): add support for `it-mil-2` and `it-mil-3` by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6526
* feat(autoscaling): add support for `it-mil-1`, `it-mil-2` and `it-mil-3`  by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6527
* feat(kafka): add support for `volume-size-bytes` in update by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6528
* feat: migrate scw redis cluster connect to use connect by @remyleone in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6496
* feat(instance): add support for listing ip with `server` and `detached` by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6536
* feat(instance): enable SG on pnics by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6539
* feat(ipam): add new lb_ip resource  by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6560
* feat(baremetal): add commitment on servers by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6578
* feat: improve visualisation for scw billing charge list by @remyleone in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6566
* feat(autocomplete): use profile flag in completion by @yfodil in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6588
* feat(instance): migrate server-type commands to v2 by @Mia-Cross in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6491
* feat(object): add support for 's3-endpoint' to bucket cmds by @pypaut in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/5636
* feat(interlink): expose dedicated connection commands in the CLI by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6614
* feat(webhosting): update database name and username requirements by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6633
* feat(search): add kvdb types by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6639
* feat(instance): migrate private-nic to v2 private-network-interface by @Mia-Cross in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6157
* feat(dns): add record import command for BIND and JSON files by @jremy42 in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/5470
* feat(instance): migrate security-group resource to v2 by @Mia-Cross in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6366
* feat(autocomplete): add support for description in autocomplete by @remyleone in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6466
* feat(instance): migrate user-data resource to v2 by @Mia-Cross in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6627
* feat(audit_trail): add kafka cluster infos by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6658
* feat: add support for going to the cockpit page of a resource by @remyleone in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6512
* feat(file): add filesystem creation from snapshot by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6666
* feat(cockpit): add rate limit config for datasource by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6683
* feat(dataviz): activate CLI by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6700
* feat(data_orchestrator): activate CLI by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6699
* feat(product_catalog): update cockpit implementation by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6732
* feat(instance): activate cli generation for volumes and snapshots by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6711
* feat(annotations): add audit trail annotations by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6739
* feat(annotations): deprecate batch delete endpoints by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6747

### Fixes

* fix(autocomplete): forward required args to list command when completing by @yfodil in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6571
* fix: remove unrequired volume deployment_id by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6579
* fix: add a guard against commands without argspecs by @remyleone in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6617
* fix(dns): create PN in record import Simple test BeforeFunc by @jremy42 in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6655
* fix(autocomplete): set default shell to /bin/bash if empty by @estellesoulard in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6661
* fix(autocomplete): use file name of the binary as default basename by @kaovilai in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6569
* fix(deps): update dependency @devcontainers/cli to v0.90.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6717

* fix(deps): update module github.com/spf13/pflag to v1.1.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6761
* fix(baremetal): add option type by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6765
* fix(deps): update aws-sdk-go-v2 monorepo by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6743
